# Dependency notices

CODEX-LICENSE and CODEX-NOTICE were retrieved unchanged from the upstream tag rust-v0.155.1:

- https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.155.1/LICENSE
- https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.155.1/NOTICE

The distributable retains Node's LICENSE and the license files shipped in npm dependencies. THIRD-PARTY.json is generated from installed package metadata. It is an inventory, not a complete legal audit of every statically linked binary dependency; that review remains part of the release gate.
